price_disclaimer: Prices are approximate, are provided as a guide only, and vary by location and day (weekends and holidays cost more). Golden Corral is an all-you-can-eat buffet priced per person, so individual items do not have prices and calories vary with what you choose. Drinks are usually extra. Last updated October 2026.
intro: Golden Corral is America's best-known all-you-can-eat buffet chain, charging one price per person for an endless spread of comfort food: fried chicken, carved meats, a hot bar, salad bar, the famous yeast rolls, and a dessert area with the chocolate wonderfall fountain. Pricing is by meal (breakfast, lunch or dinner) and by age, with senior discounts. Below are the full Golden Corral buffet prices for 2026 and what you'll find on the buffet.
quick_answer: Golden Corral is an all-you-can-eat buffet priced per person: weekday lunch is about $11.49, dinner is around $16.99, and breakfast is $9.99 to $12.99 where offered. Seniors get a discount (about $10.99 lunch, $15.99 dinner), kids 4 to 8 are $8.99, and a drink is about $2.69. The yeast rolls, fried chicken and chocolate fountain are the icons.
hot_deal: Golden Corral value: the whole concept is value, and weekday lunch (about $11.49) is the cheapest way in. Seniors get a discount at lunch and dinner, and kids are priced by age, with the youngest often free with a paying adult. Drinks are usually extra, so water keeps the bill down. Prices vary by location and are higher on weekends and holidays.

faqs.q: How much is the Golden Corral buffet?
faqs.a: It is priced per person: weekday lunch is about $11.49, dinner around $16.99, and breakfast $9.99 to $12.99 where offered. Weekends and holidays cost a little more. Drinks are usually extra, about $2.69.

faqs.q: Does Golden Corral have a senior discount?
faqs.a: Yes. Seniors get a reduced buffet price, roughly $10.99 for weekday lunch and $15.99 for dinner. The exact discount and age cutoff vary by location, so it is worth asking at the register.

faqs.q: How much is Golden Corral for kids?
faqs.a: Kids are priced by age: ages 4 to 8 are about $8.99 and 9 to 12 about $10.49. The youngest children (often under 3 or 4) frequently eat free with a paying adult, with a limit per adult, though rules vary by location.

faqs.q: What is on the Golden Corral buffet?
faqs.a: An all-you-can-eat spread of fried chicken, carved meats, pot roast, mashed potatoes, the famous warm yeast rolls, a salad bar, soups, and a big dessert area with the chocolate wonderfall fountain and soft serve. Breakfast adds eggs, bacon, pancakes and waffles.

faqs.q: What is Golden Corral best known for?
faqs.a: Golden Corral is best known as America's all-you-can-eat family buffet, famous for its warm yeast rolls, golden fried chicken, carving station and the chocolate wonderfall fountain for dessert.
